lead.title: NVIDIA's RTX Spark desktops go on sale with up to 128GB unified memory
lead.summary: NVIDIA's RTX Spark compact desktops went on sale November 18 from ASUS, Dell and MSI, pairing a 20-core Grace CPU with a 6,144-CUDA-core Blackwell GPU and up to 128GB of unified memory. NVIDIA claims supported models up to 120B parameters run locally; MSI's EdgeMesa N AI+ starts at $4,699, with Acer, GIGABYTE, HP and a Microsoft Surface Dev Box to follow.

top_stories.title: Rumble-2-Flash: a 0.5B open-weights speech model for 40+ languages
top_stories.summary: Reson8 open-sourced Rumble-2-Flash, an Apache 2.0 ASR model with automatic language detection, native Transformers/vLLM support and 7,000+ RTFx. It matches NVIDIA's 30B Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark despite being ~60x smaller.

top_stories.title: RadixArk ships DaisyRose-27B, its first open-weight model
top_stories.summary: Built on Qwen3.8-27B and post-trained with RL on 1,200 curated long-horizon agent tasks in 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs, DaisyRose-27B ships BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 checkpoints under Apache 2.0, with Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 improving from 5.6% to 12.0%.

top_stories.title: Hugging Face runs a 180B MoE on 32GB of RAM by streaming experts from SSD
top_stories.summary: A new Transformers technique keeps only hot MoE experts in VRAM and overflows the rest to RAM or disk, reaching within 6% of a dedicated engine's token-generation speed on a 32GB unified-memory MacBook.

top_stories.title: Google DeepMind launches Genie 4 in Project Genie
top_stories.summary: Genie 4 adds native audio, real-time editing and a new agent for creating interactive virtual worlds, rolling out to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers.

items.title: QDA: closed-loop LLM quantization design with agents
items.summary: An MIT HAN Lab method that puts an LLM agent in a closed loop to automatically design per-model quantization recipes — scale scheme, structure and precision allocation — replacing manual tuning.

items.title: Tideway: phase-aware tiered memory for MoE inference on consumer devices
items.summary: Phase-aware tiered memory management targets the VRAM gap between datacenter servers and local hardware, letting large MoE models deploy on consumer PCs.

items.title: Late Entry in looped language models
items.summary: Addresses how early-exit decoding truncates cached KV states in looped (shared-layer) language models, improving the recurrence-depth versus decoding-latency trade-off.

items.title: MoE-Context: show the model only what it needs
items.summary: Splits agent context into blocks and uses a fast yes/no pre-pass to select only the blocks each step needs, cutting per-step context length while keeping the rest recallable.

items.title: Replay, don't resample: cheaper consolidation of long-horizon RL experts
items.summary: Replaces costly multi-teacher on-policy distillation with an off-policy replay scheme for merging per-domain RL experts into a single student model.

items.title: Tencent Hy4-flash: 220B MoE multimodal model goes open-weight
items.summary: Image-text-to-text instruct model released with an FP8 variant and a pretrained base (Hy4-flash-base); trending on Hugging Face.

items.title: Tencent WeDLM-8B-Base: diffusion language model with parallel decoding
items.summary: 8B diffusion LM decoding in parallel under standard causal attention, initialized from Qwen3-8B; Apache 2.0 base checkpoint with an instruct sibling available.

items.title: Microsoft's Aion 1.0 Instruct: a 2.3B compact on-device model
items.summary: New 2.3B open-weights instruct model released November 18; its compact footprint makes it a strong candidate for on-device local inference.

items.title: Pitot: OpenTelemetry, Parquet, DuckDB and MCP in one binary
items.summary: Show HN launch of a single-binary observability stack that stores OpenTelemetry data as Parquet, queries it with DuckDB and exposes results over MCP for agent consumption.

items.title: ADE Index: a sourced, ranked index of 975 agentic coding tools
items.summary: A curated, cited index making the fragmented local coding-agent tool landscape comparable at a glance, launched via Show HN.

items.title: Mastra open-sources its internal software factory
items.summary: The Mastra team released the internal software factory behind its agent framework as a reproducible template for agentic project scaffolding.

items.title: SGLang adds Humming low-bit kernels for efficient MoE serving
items.summary: lmsys reports Humming low-bit kernels in SGLang for efficient MoE serving, tested on DeepSeek models.

items.title: llama.cpp MoE host-memory cache doubles token throughput on small-VRAM GPUs
items.summary: Community benchmarks from the v1.0 series report the new MoE expert cache with CPU share runs mixture-of-experts models up to ~2x faster when experts spill into system RAM (an 8GB RTX 3070 went from 35 to 62 t/s on a 35B 4-bit model). Ollama's bundled llama.cpp does not yet enable the setting.

items.title: Ollama releases cut Qwen3.8 Flash Next memory by ~27 GiB on Apple silicon
items.summary: Recent releases also route 'ollama launch claude' to the selected model, honor truncation in /v1/responses, return an empty list from /v1/models when nothing is installed, and add CUDA 13.5 support for Windows on ARM.

items.title: LORE: a fully local, Dockerized AI reader turns ebooks into knowledge graphs
items.summary: Surfaced in the r/selfhosted New Project Megathread: answers questions about your ebooks without spoilers, running fully local.

items.title: 84GB RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell launches in Japan; US listings top $20,000
items.summary: The Workstation Edition (21,760 CUDA cores, 84GB GDDR7 with ECC) began shipping via Ryosan Ryoyo on November 18; US reseller listings put it above the 96GB RTX PRO 6000 at $17,408-$20,238.

items.title: TrendForce: NAND spot-contract gap exceeds 20% as DDR5 holds steady
items.summary: Branded DDR5 spot prices held largely steady while DDR4 1Gx8 slipped 1.43% to $44.25, and weak demand pushed the NAND spot-contract gap past 20% amid channel destocking.

items.title: China Telecom trains a 285B agentic MoE entirely on 8,192 Ascend 910C NPUs
items.summary: The TeleChat Xing4 report details a fully non-NVIDIA stack (MindSpore HyperParallel, no CUDA) and introduces a 29B-A4B open-weight model with 256K-1M context for edge-class deployment.

items.title: Valve posts AMDGPU patches to cut Proton stutter via batched VRAM mapping
items.summary: A revised 10-patch Linux series introduces AMDGPU_GEM_VA2 to batch GPU virtual-memory mapping calls, targeting stalls on 8GB-class cards when dedicated VRAM runs low; RADV must adopt the interface first.
